text:
josh: Morning team — targetting Py/TS SDK release tonight in the 23:00 UTC quiet window. Main items: publish wheels, npm packages, sign artifacts, push dist-tag, and publish deprecation note for legacy sync client.

maria: thx — what's the plan if wheel signing fails? we need rollback instructions.

josh: plan A: publish both, tag `latest`, announce. Plan B (if py wheels fail): hold py publish, proceed with TS only, flip back dist-tag once py fixed. Rollback: unpublish or yank wheel + create patch.

sam: notif: CI jobs green locally. One ask: can we avoid auto-disttag until we confirm macOS wheel checksums? add a manual gate.

luke: I'll add manual gate to the pypi pipeline. Patch in CI: check `gpg --verify dist/*.sig dist/*.whl` and `twine check dist/*` before dist-tag step.

deploy-bot: [ci/publish-py] started by josh

elena: doing a quick smoke on macos-latest now. ping me when artifacts are ready.

deploy-bot: [ci/publish-py] failed — signature mismatch on `redwood_sdk-1.4.0-cp310-macosx_11_0_arm64.whl`

elena: confirmed checksum mismatch on one mac wheel :warning: — looks like our build runner produced a different binary. Failing tests for arm64 packaging.

josh: ok hold py publish. Sam / Luke — please stop dist-tag step and start a republish job after we fix the build. Proceed with TS publish and release notes only.

sam: doing that now. I'll open a short rollback ticket if dist-tag already flipped. Adding `SKIP_PY_DISTTAG=true` env flag to the release job.

kevin: FYI security needs to re-run sig verification with HSM after republish. Add to post-publish checklist: `HSM:verify` and `audit log entry`.

deploy-bot: [ci/publish-ts] succeeded — npm package redwood-js-sdk@1.4.0 published :shipit:

maria: I'll update release notes to mention py publish delayed and deprecation schedule stays but deprecation announcement will be postponed until py wheels validated.

josh: good. Elena — can you triage mac runner? ETA to rebuild and re-run artifact signer?

elena: starting rebuild now, probably 40m. will post logs here.

deploy-bot: [ci/publish-py-retry] queued by luke

luke: pushed a fix to the mac build image and requeued. Also added `twine check` and checksum verification to the publish job.

deploy-bot: [ci/publish-py-retry] succeeded — wheels uploaded and signatures verified

kevin: HSM verify done, audit log OK.

josh: great. final step: sam please flip dist-tag `latest` to 1.4.0 and publish the release note. After that we can send the deprecation announcement tomorrow PST.

sam: flipping dist-tag now: `npm dist-tag add @redwood/js-sdk@1.4.0 latest` and `python -m pip index versions redwood-sdk` — dist-tag updated.

maria: release notes published: https://company.internal/releases/1.4.0

josh: thanks all. Postmortem / quick notes: avoid auto-disttag for mixed-platform releases, add mac arm64 smoke in preflight, and keep deprecation announcements gated on full artifact verification. :memo:

elena: noted. will add the smoke job to preflight pipeline.

maria: closing thread — will schedule deprecation email for tomorrow after we verify client adoption metrics.
